description: Add enhanced animations to Hero section and CodeEditor component: floating animation on the code editor, gradient text effect on heading, animated background blobs, improved scribble animation, staggered text reveal, and pulse animation on CTA button. Must preserve all existing functionality including navigation links, Button component behavior, and RTL text handling.
steps: 1. In src/components/sections/Hero.css: Add @keyframes float for subtle up-down floating (transform: translateY), add .gradient-text class with background-clip and linear-gradient animation, add @keyframes blob-move for organic blob movement, add animated background shapes using ::before/::after pseudo-elements with blur and low opacity

2. In src/components/sections/Hero.jsx: Add floating animation variant to CodeEditor wrapper using Framer Motion animate prop with y oscillation (useAnimation or animate keyframes), wrap h1 text in motion.span elements for staggered character/word reveal by extending containerVariants children delay, apply gradient-text class to heading highlight span

3. In src/components/sections/Hero.css: Enhance .scribble animation with custom easing and slight overshoot, add CSS variables for animation timing that respect prefers-reduced-motion by setting --anim-duration to 0s in reduced motion media query

4. In src/components/sections/CodeEditor.jsx: Add useReducedMotion hook check and conditionally disable floating animation. Add subtle floating animation to the editor wrapper using motion.div with animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }} and repeat: Infinity

5. In src/components/sections/CodeEditor.css: Add @keyframes float-subtle with transform: translateY, apply to .editor with animation: float-subtle 4s ease-in-out infinite. Add CSS to disable animation when prefers-reduced-motion via :global selector
6. In src/components/ui/Button.jsx: Add pulse animation variant to primary button on hover using whileHover scale with boxShadow animation cycle. Ensure spring physics for natural feel
7. Verify: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors. All existing button links ('#roadmap', '#lessons') must still work.
acceptance_criteria: CodeEditor has smooth floating animation (transform only, not layout-triggering properties)
Main heading has animated gradient text effect that cycles colors
Background has subtle animated blob shapes that move organically
Scribble underline animation has improved easing with slight overshoot effect
Paragraph text reveals with staggered word/line animation on page load
CTA button has pulsing glow effect on hover
All animations disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is set
npm run build passes with no errors
